key_finding: January 2026 MDPI study achieves Brier 0.199 — 0.021 better than our fleet best. The winning combination is spatial shot-chart zone aggregates (not raw player stats) fed into a GRU/RNN, with Monte Carlo dropout providing calibrated uncertainty estimates. Logistic regression + shot-chart embeddings alone beats XGBoost in their comparison.

proposals.title: Add shot-zone aggregate features to engine.py
proposals.rationale: The SOTA gap (0.021) is primarily explained by spatial shot-chart features — zone efficiency (paint/mid-range/3PT by zone), shot selection tendencies, and opponent defensive zone ratings. These are addable to engine.py as rolling-average features per team. Data source: NBA Stats API shot zone dashboard, already in our data pipeline context.
proposals.implementation_path: features/engine.py: add ~12 new shot-zone category features (off_paint_freq, def_3pt_zone_pct, etc.) → re-run GA on S22 clone → measure brier delta
proposals.blocker: Shot-zone data must be available in nba_cached_data.npz or added to data pipeline

proposals.title: Monte Carlo dropout calibration head for post-training uncertainty
proposals.rationale: MC dropout (T=30 forward passes at inference) wrapping any scikit-learn model via a thin neural calibration head. The SOTA paper uses this to reduce ECE from 0.041 to 0.018. Our isotonic-calibrated CV Brier is 0.22054 — the MC dropout head could push this further. Feasible on Colab T4 as a post-hoc calibration layer over our best XGBoost/ExtraTrees.
proposals.implementation_path: scripts/kaggle/nba_karpathy_loop.py: add MCDropoutCalibrator class wrapping best model → evaluate on holdout → compare to isotonic
proposals.blocker: Needs GPU session (Colab T4 or Kaggle P100)

proposals.title: Stacked ensemble meta-learner (LR+XGB+ExtraTrees+Ridge)
proposals.rationale: Nature 2025 paper achieves Brier 0.221 with 4-model stacking. Our islands are single-model per individual. A stacking layer (LR meta) over S22-ExtraTrees + S14-RF + S18-ExtraTrees could combine diversity and accuracy. Note CLAUDE.md Rule 8: stacking removed from CPU islands — this should be a GPU-burst-only experiment.
proposals.implementation_path: scripts/gpu-burst/zerogpu-burst.py or modal-burst.py: add StackedNBAEnsemble experiment
proposals.blocker: Rule 8 prohibits stacking on CPU islands; GPU burst only

recommended_next_action: P1 (shot-zone features) is the highest-impact CPU-feasible improvement. Request HAWKEYE or DR FRANKENSTEIN to audit NBA Stats API shot-zone dashboard availability in the current data pipeline and add ~12 zone features to engine.py v3.2.
